addons/intelligence/app/extraction.py:192-219: store_original_if_absent now takes a keyword-only `snapshot: tuple[str, str] | None = None` and uses `snapshot or snapshot_transcript(session, file_id)` at 210-212. extraction.py is in r1/product-files.txt and is not in the spec's touch points (122-133). refine.py:872 now adds only result.skipped_count. Lines 948-949 add len(applied_ids) to refined_total and len(refined_window)-len(applied_ids) to skipped_total. The intelligence.refine.completed payload at 1003-1009 sends these totals. docs/process/spec-and-design.md:41-43 asks for events that are added or changed. The spec body (refine-alignment-failure.md:108-109) does say skipped_count includes chunks that failed realignment. But the Touch points list (122-133) does not name the event, and the change to refined_count, which now counts applied chunks only, is not stated anywhere.

The refine_chunks docstring at refine.py:145-151 now describes the new behaviour ("the caller decides whether to persist them, because a chunk whose words cannot be realigned is left as it was"), so it was edited, and refine_chunks is not a listed touch point.
